annotations.title: Buy a credit pack with PayPal (sandbox)

description: Start a one-off credit purchase for the signed-in account: pack_1k = 1,000 credits for US$8.00; pack_5k = 5,000 credits for US$35.00; pack_20k = 20,000 credits for US$120.00. Returns a PayPal approval link to show the user — they approve the payment on PayPal's page (never paste card details into the chat); then call confirm_credit_purchase with the order_id. Pack credits are spent after the monthly plan allowance and never expire. Sandbox only: test money. Free to call; needs the user's account.
name: buy_credits
